extracted.intended_audience: consumers interested in the DEWI11 online gaming platform and customers of iStudio trade-in program
extracted.subtask_description: A mixed product/marketing page for the DEWI11 online gaming platform with embedded iStudio trade-in program terms and FAQs; includes eligibility requirements, procedural rules, and user-facing advice. The rubric-like items are the eligibility/terms, required actions, and usage guidance presented to prospective customers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer age requirement
rubrics_metrics.description: Customer affirms that s/he is at least legally 18 years of age.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility rule in the Terms and Conditions: customers must be at least 18 to participate in the trade-in programme.

rubrics_metrics.name: Customer authorization/ownership
rubrics_metrics.description: "Customer" means the undersigned that is the owner of the Product or has been authorised by the owner of the Product to make decisions on the Product.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Only the owner or an authorised person may trade in a device; documentation or proof of authority may be required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Third-party provision of programme
rubrics_metrics.description: The Trade-in programme is provided to iStudio customers by Laku6 as a third party company. Apple is not a party in the transaction.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Clarifies which entity operates the programme and which parties are not legally involved (Apple).

rubrics_metrics.name: iStudio/Laku6 right to refuse, cancel, or limit programme
rubrics_metrics.description: Laku6 and iStudio reserve the right to refuse, cancel, or limit the programme for any reason and may change these terms and conditions at any time without prior notice.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Program availability and terms can be altered unilaterally; customers should not assume permanence of offers.

rubrics_metrics.name: Lawful use and indemnity
rubrics_metrics.description: The Programme is provided for lawful purposes only, to the extent permitted by law, Customer agrees to indemnify iStudio, Laku6, its affiliate and any of its directors, officers, employees, affiliates, subsidiaries or agents from and against claims brought against any of them arising from Customer's breach of terms and conditions of the Programme.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customers are responsible for legal compliance and must indemnify the providers for breaches; this is a contractual liability requirement.

rubrics_metrics.name: Location availability restriction
rubrics_metrics.description: iStudio trade-in programme is only available at all iStudio stores (excluding Airport Terminal Stores).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trade-ins cannot be completed at Airport Terminal Stores; customers must attend eligible physical iStudio locations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Total trade-in value non-transferable
rubrics_metrics.description: Total trade-in value is not transferable.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Value awarded for a trade-in cannot be transferred to another person or account.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to refuse eligibility for breach/suspected breach
rubrics_metrics.description: iStudio reserves the right to refuse any customer's eligibility at any time in its discretion in the event of such customer's breach or suspected breach of any of the terms and conditions herein without prior notification or any liability to such customer whatsoever.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Eligibility may be revoked if terms are or are suspected to be breached; stores have discretionary authority.

rubrics_metrics.name: Right to vary terms with notice where practicable
rubrics_metrics.description: iStudio reserves the right to vary any term or condition. iStudio will, where it is practicable to do so, give customers advance notice (which may be through written notice, electronic mail letters, iStudio website, or such other forms as iStudio deems appropriate) of such changes.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Terms may change; when practicable, iStudio will attempt to notify customers through listed channels.

rubrics_metrics.name: One device per eligible trade-in
rubrics_metrics.description: This iStudio Trade-in programme is limited to one (1) device per eligible trade-in.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Programmatic limit: each trade-in transaction may only involve a single device for valuation and credit.

rubrics_metrics.name: Required items for assessment (charger/cable)
rubrics_metrics.description: What do I need to bring along? You will be required to bring your charger and cable for laptops.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customers should bring necessary accessories to allow proper assessment and powering of the device.

rubrics_metrics.name: Assessment inability for non-powering devices
rubrics_metrics.description: We would not be able to assess your device if we are unable to power on your device.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Devices that cannot power on cannot be assessed and therefore are ineligible for trade-in under normal assessment procedures.

rubrics_metrics.name: Remove and keep memory cards
rubrics_metrics.description: Do I get to keep the memory card from the trade-in devices? We recommend that you remove and keep all your memory cards before you trade-in a device.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customers must remove personal storage media prior to trade-in to retain data and property.

rubrics_metrics.name: Trade-ins final; cannot retrieve old device
rubrics_metrics.description: Would I be able to get back my old device back after the trade-in? You would not be able to retrieve your old device as all trade-ins are final. Prior to trading in your device, we recommend backing up all your important content such as contacts, photos, videos, etc.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Trade-in is irrevocable; customers must backup data and understand they will not reclaim the device.

rubrics_metrics.name: Acceptance option after assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: What if I do not like the value after assessment? You can choose to not accept the trade-in value, but the value shown is final.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Customers may decline the offered value, but the assessed figure is final and not negotiable for that assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Device not listed — in-store assessment
rubrics_metrics.description: What if my device is not found in the trade-in device list? You can head down to our stores to get your device assessed by our iStudio Experts to check if it is accepted.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Unlisted models may still be considered via in-person expert assessment.

rubrics_metrics.name: Maximum purchase / product limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Sorry! you reached maximum limit for this product!
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Inventory or purchase limits may block adding more units to cart; customers should check quantity limits.

rubrics_metrics.name: Shipping timing information
rubrics_metrics.description: Shipping: Typically ships in 1-3 days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Estimated fulfillment time for shipped orders; customers should expect this typical timeframe.

rubrics_metrics.name: User advice for game-play (strategic hours)
rubrics_metrics.description: Trik Simpel Jadi Juara di DEWI11: Para juara di DEWI11 tidak main asal tekan. Mereka memanfaatkan stabilitas server DEWI11 untuk bermain di jam-jam strategis. Dengan respon server yang super cepat, setiap putaran terasa lebih presisi...
rubrics_metrics.guidance: User-level guidance/marketing advice suggesting that playing during strategic hours leverages server stability and faster response times to improve outcomes; presented as promotional advice rather than a verified guarantee.

rubrics_metrics.name: Feature claims about deposits and withdrawals
rubrics_metrics.description: Deposit hitungan detik, withdraw tanpa ribet. Anda menang, Anda tarik saat itu juga.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Operational claims about rapid deposit and withdrawal processing intended to reassure prospective players; these are marketing assertions rather than contractual guarantees.
